title: Presales Executive
description:
**About the Role** Shree Rakhi is looking for a bright, conversation-driven, and curious professional to join our in-store team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for our customers over the phone, ensuring they receive a warm, professional reception before being routed to the right team member.

Beyond communication, you will dive deep into our product lines, actively assisting in catalog preparation and providing essential support to our sales operations. If you are eager to learn about the business, possess strong CRM skills, and approach your work with genuine good intent, we want you on our team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Call Handling & Warm Transfers:** Manage incoming customer calls with a welcoming tone. Understand the customer's core needs and execute smooth, professional "warm transfers" to the concerned person or department.
* **Product & Catalog Management:** Develop a thorough understanding of our extensive Rakhi product range. Actively assist the team in preparing, updating, and managing product catalogs.
* **Sales Support:** Act as the backbone for the sales team. Assist with daily sales operations, follow-ups, and ensure customer requests are logged and addressed promptly.
* **CRM Management:** Utilize CRM tools to track customer interactions, update caller details, and maintain accurate records of inquiries and transfers.
* **Continuous Learning:** Actively study the business model, seasonal trends, and new product lines to provide accurate information to callers and support the in-store team effectively.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Communication:** Exceptional conversational skills in English, Hindi, and/or the local language. Ability to speak clearly, listen actively, and build immediate rapport.
* **Technical Skills:** Prior experience using CRM software and a good grasp of basic computer applications (MS Office, cataloging tools).
* **Experience:** Background in customer support, sales support, or front-desk operations is a strong plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* **Curious Mindset:** A natural desire to learn about our products, understand how the business works, and figure out how to best solve customer queries.
* **Good Intent:** Driven by a genuine desire to help customers and support colleagues. Empathetic, patient, and positive.
* **Detail-Oriented:** Keen eye for detail, especially when helping prepare product catalogs and entering data into the CRM.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹33,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
